label: 1.1.1 正式版
notes: 修复：每日挑战从来不记成绩（run.daily 从没被设置）
修复：8 个成就永远解锁不了（死内容，现已全部实现）
修复：战斗结束悬停大图不消失
修复：读档继续战役后解锁过滤失效
修复：音效初始化时机不对可能永久静音
改进：新存档送一批稀有卡，前期奖励不再清一色普通卡
notes_en: Fix: daily challenge never recorded any score (the daily flag was never set)
Fix: 8 achievements could never be earned (dead content, now all implemented)
Fix: the card hover preview stayed on screen after a battle ended
Fix: unlock filtering broke after loading a saved run
Fix: sound effects could end up permanently muted due to init timing
Improved: new saves start with a batch of rarer cards so early rewards aren't all common
